title: Daily 5, Fri 27 Nov
sourceNote: Original questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 5 questions, 10 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Everyone gets the same five. The ranking is by marks, then by time.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, rupee sign or units.

questions.text: An article costs ₹500. It is sold at a 20% discount on its marked price and still makes a profit of 12%. What is the marked price?
Walking at 3/4 of his usual speed, Arjun reaches his office 20 minutes late. How long does the walk usually take him?
A two-digit number is 4 times the sum of its digits. When 27 is added to it, its digits swap places. What is the number?
If −3 ≤ x ≤ 2 and −1 ≤ y ≤ 4, what is the largest possible value of x − y?
A sum of money is divided among A, B and C in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. C gets ₹1,500 more than A. What is the whole sum, in rupees?
